title: Captain Quasar & Pat-Tron
description: Captain Quasar is negotiating a treaty with the leader of the Saladrian Empire when something goes horribly wrong. He must travel with Pat-Tron to his home planet, Tron-Tron, and meet his family.
quote: I’m not like you machines! I’m not meant for this cold metal world.
altHero: Captain Quasar, a shark, and Pat-Tron, a robot
alt1: Captain Quasar negotiating with the leader of the Saladrian Empire, a bowl of salad
alt2: Captain Quasar looking out the window sadly as parts of a ship float by in space
alt3: Captain Quasar and Pat-Tron at his childhood home, his parents opening the door
alt4: Captain Quasar pouring a bag of space rice into a small pool
